notes.subject: ברד/ברדת · שפלה/תשפל
notes.rationale: Go tloša mantšu: go theoga ga sehlaga (yarad) go boelediša le go wa ga mekulu (barad); šefela/tišpola go bopa kgokagano ya mantsu a theogago — se se laleditšwego phetolelong

notes.subject: motse o tla theogišwa fase
notes.rationale: Ba fetoleli ba fapana: ba bangwe ba re motse o tla hlwa ka šafeleng (ASV), ba bangwe ba re o tla theogela mothalong (JPS); sehlwa se bolela go theoga goba go tlaelwa

translation: Gomme mekulu e tla wa ge sehlaga se theoga, gomme sebakeng se se tlase motse o tla theogišwa fase.
